streetAddress.location: 4900 S University Dr, Davie, FL 33328, USA

position.description:
ADOLESCENT SERVICES MANAGER

On-Site | Davie, FL | Monday-Friday | Full-Time 

About the Role

Lead the day-to-day experience of an adolescent mental health program where structure, consistency, and connection matter. You’ll lead the team and systems that keep each day running smoothly while creating a safe, supportive environment for adolescents and families. This role is ideal for someone who can lead people, create structure, solve problems, and build an environment where adolescents can succeed.

Backgrounds that translate well: Education · School Administration · Student Services · Youth Programs · Behavioral Health · Program Management

What You'll Do

• Lead the daily adolescent program experience, maintaining a safe, structured, and welcoming environment
• Supervise Wellness Coordinators through clear expectations, coaching, feedback, and accountability
• Keep daily program flow on track, including staff coverage, schedules, attendance, census, and intake coordination
• Build positive relationships with adolescents and help the team respond effectively to behavioral, emotional, and day-to-day needs
• Partner with therapists, families, and program leadership to support a consistent client experience
• Monitor documentation, incident reporting, safety protocols, and compliance requirements
• Anticipate challenges, respond calmly in the moment, and keep the program on track through changes
• Coordinate facility, supply, and administrative needs that impact the adolescent experience

What We're Looking For

• 2+ years of experience in education, school administration, youth services, behavioral health, program management, or team leadership
• Experience supervising or leading others
• Strong organization and ability to manage multiple priorities and changing needs
• Confident setting expectations, providing feedback, and holding others accountable
• Calm, solutions-focused approach to challenging situations
• Strong attention to documentation, policies, safety, and established processes
• Ability to connect with adolescents while maintaining appropriate structure and boundaries
• Eligible for DCF and AHCA Level 2 background screening and drug testing
• Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent experience considered

About AWA

AWA provides adolescent mental health PHP and IOP services across South Florida. We support teens and families through structured, compassionate environments designed to help adolescents grow.

Learn More: Adolescent Wellness Academy

Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Program Operations Supervisor – Adolescent Mental Health position with Adolescent Wellness Academy. The opportunity immediately stood out to me because it combines the areas in which I have built my professional experience—youth program operations, staff leadership, compliance, family engagement, and creating structured and supportive environments for young people.

In my most recent leadership position, I managed the daily operations of a large youth program, supervised a team of up to 17 staff members, coordinated scheduling and staff coverage, maintained program documentation and compliance requirements, communicated regularly with families, responded to incidents, and helped ensure a safe and organized environment for approximately 100 students. I also hold active DCF Staff and Director Credentials.

My educational background in psychology and my professional experience supporting children with behavioral, developmental, and social-emotional needs have strengthened my interest in adolescent mental health. I have developed a leadership approach that combines accountability and organization with empathy, de-escalation, mentorship, and respect for the individual needs of young people and their families.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring my program management experience, systems thinking, and commitment to youth development to Adolescent Wellness Academy. I am particularly excited about the opportunity to transition my established operational leadership experience into an adolescent mental health setting and contribute to a program serving young people and families during critical periods in their lives.

Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my experience and leadership background could contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Tamara Riley

In my current role as an Assistant Director with New York Edge, I help oversee the daily operations of a large after-school program serving more than 500 middle school students. I supervise and coach staff, coordinate schedules and staffing coverage, support program implementation, and step into a site leadership role when the Program Director is unavailable. This experience has strengthened my ability to manage competing priorities, maintain structure, address challenges in real time, and ensure that both staff and students have the support they need to be successful.

A significant part of my role involves working directly with adolescents and creating an environment where students feel supported while clear expectations and boundaries are maintained. I have experience responding to behavioral concerns, communicating with families and staff, addressing incidents appropriately, and following established policies and safety procedures. I understand the importance of remaining calm and solutions-focused when unexpected situations arise, while also ensuring consistency and accountability across a team.

I also bring strong organizational and administrative skills. From managing staff schedules and daily program logistics to monitoring attendance, coordinating activities, communicating with multiple stakeholders, and ensuring that program expectations are followed, I am accustomed to keeping complex youth programs running smoothly. I take pride in anticipating potential challenges, identifying solutions, and creating systems that allow both staff and students to have a positive and consistent experience.

My educational background further supports my interest in this position. I hold a Bachelor's degree in Psychology and a Master's degree in School Counseling, which have given me a strong foundation in adolescent development, social-emotional needs, communication, and creating supportive environments for young people. While my professional background has been primarily in education and youth programming rather than clinical mental health services, I am particularly drawn to AWA's focus on providing adolescents and families with a structured, compassionate environment in which they can grow.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring my leadership experience, organizational skills, and passion for supporting adolescents to AWA. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my experience could contribute to your team and the adolescents and families you serve.

Sincerely,

Dear Hiring Manager:

I am writing to express my interest in the Program Operations Supervisor – Adolescent Mental Health position with AWA. With more than 20 years of supervisory and operational experience, along with a Master of Science in Forensic Psychology, I offer a strong combination of people leadership, organizational oversight, crisis response, documentation, and compliance awareness.

In my current role as a Public Safety Supervisor at the Miami Beach Convention Center, I help manage daily operations in a fast-paced environment where safety, coverage, communication, and accountability are essential. My responsibilities include coordinating staff assignments, addressing callouts and coverage needs, providing clear direction, monitoring performance, responding to incidents, preparing detailed reports, and communicating operational concerns to leadership and outside agencies. Throughout my career, I have remained calm under pressure, managed competing priorities, de-escalated difficult situations, and ensured that established procedures were followed.

Although my professional background has primarily been in public safety and operations, my graduate education in forensic psychology provides a valuable foundation for working within an adolescent mental health setting. My studies strengthened my understanding of human behavior, crisis intervention, community-based challenges, trauma, and the importance of treating individuals and families with patience, dignity, and respect. I understand that this position is not a clinical role, but one that ensures the program remains organized, appropriately staffed, compliant, and responsive to the needs of clients, families, and clinical personnel.

I would bring to AWA a structured yet compassionate leadership style, strong documentation and incident-management skills, and the ability to communicate clearly with employees, clinicians, families, and leadership. I am confident delegating responsibilities, following up on assignments, addressing performance concerns, and identifying operational risks before they interfere with service delivery.

AWA’s commitment to supporting adolescents and their families strongly resonates with me. I would welcome the opportunity to apply my leadership experience and educational background to help maintain a safe, organized, and client-centered program.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my experience and qualifications can contribute to AWA’s mission.

Sincerely,

LeAnn Cintron

I am especially interested in project management and am seeking an internship that will allow me to gain hands-on experience, learn industry practices, and better understand how projects are planned, executed, monitored, and successfully completed.

In my current role, I execute national, theater, and local emergency action plans and coordinate with senior leaders, security forces, medical personnel, maintenance teams, and external agencies during emergencies and contingencies. I have supported unified response actions for four in-flight emergencies, 28 security forces incidents, and a tropical storm, contributing to the protection of $944 million in installation assets. I have also trained command post controllers, improved emergency procedures, and developed guidance that strengthened information security and operational readiness. These experiences have required me to manage competing priorities, communicate across functional teams, track critical information, and ensure tasks are completed accurately and on time—skills that directly align with project management.

My international experience as a Joint Operations Center Recovery Controller at Soto Cano Air Base, Honduras, further strengthened my interest in coordination and project-focused work. I supported 57 initiatives across Central America, including Civil Affairs engagements and medical readiness activities benefiting more than 3,145 patients and animals. I also supported casualty evacuation, disaster relief exercises, and partner-nation operations. Working across multiple missions and stakeholders showed me the importance of planning, organization, resource coordination, adaptability, and clear communication in achieving a shared objective.

In addition to my military experience, I hold a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science from Florida International University and am completing my graduate studies in Disaster Management. While my professional and academic background has provided me with a strong foundation in emergency operations and leadership, I am eager to learn more about project management in a professional setting. I am seeking an internship where I can learn from experienced project managers, strengthen my understanding of project management methodologies and tools, and apply my existing leadership and coordination skills to real-world projects.

I bring a willingness to learn, a strong work ethic, and experience performing in environments where organization, accountability, and effective communication are essential. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to your team while developing the project management knowledge and practical experience needed for the next stage of my career. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my experience, interest in project management, and commitment to professional growth can contribute to your organization.

Sincerely,

Kim F. Saint-Louis

candidates.cover_letter:
To Adolescent Wellness Academy,

	My name is Daniela Gutierrez, I am an active immigration paralegal in the Children’s Legal Program with background and experience as a Case Manager with the Office of Refugee Resettlement. I write to express my interest in the Adolescence Service Manager position. My academic background in Psychology and experience as a Case Manager for unaccompanied children with the Office of Refugee Resettlement (ORR) has equipped me with the skill and tact necessary to manage crisis intervention and trauma-informed care for resident youth. As an experienced paralegal, I hold skills and experience in various matters I believe to be beneficial to you and your clients. 

When working with youth, communication is my top-priority to ensure clients feel safe, informed and comfortable with their Legal and care team as they navigate the tough and complex legal system. In immigration, it is not uncommon to have a case where abuse is involved, and it is extremely important to be able to identify when a client may be in an unsafe environment and know how to approach these situations with sensitivity, delicacy and care. As a case manager, I was responsible for approximately 8 in-house residents at a time, who recently immigrated from their home country and served as their intermediate stay between ICE custody release and family reunification. During their placement, I worked closely with their counseling team and teachers to provide curated service plans and goals while in the program, for the duration of their family reunification case. Through this experience, I have learned how to balance casework with strict deadlines, adhering to program policies and procedures, and maintaining an organized system and effective task management, while simultaneously providing empathetic and sensitive support to our resident boys ages 13-17, going through a difficult reunification process or legal conflicts, experienced recent traumatic events or dealing with a troubled past, and current ongoing therapeutic sessions which may impact behavior. 

As a legal assistant, my responsibility is to serve as a point-of-contact to ensure clients are attended to throughout their case’s progression and to relay important information in a timely manner. It is of high-priority to me, being fluent in Spanish, that Spanish-speaking clients are not excluded in familiarity, understanding and clarity of their entire legal progress. It is crucial to provide clients legal services with empathy and reassurance they have someone to depend on as they are dealing with the emotions behind legal matters. Throughout my professional career, I have recognized the importance of maintaining detailed records as well as documentation and reporting of significant events relevant to a client’s casework.  

After navigating the hurdles of immigration law, I’m dedicated to bring my knowledge and skills in a new field while utilizing my expertise in family matters and delicate events or trauma. My capabilities of excelling in this position are not limited to the skills I've considered in this letter. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss what my experience and background can offer you and your clients to establish strong rapport and deliver effective care.

Sincerely,

Kelsie Claudette Mathis

candidates.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,
Some of the most meaningful work we can do is help a young person recognize that their current circumstances do not have to define their future. That is what draws me to the Adolescent Service Manager position with Adolescent Wellness Academy.
My career has given me the opportunity to work with individuals across a wide range of ages and needs, but two experiences in particular have shaped the way I approach behavioral health and service leadership: my work with adolescents at Dade Juvenile Detention Center and my most recent role as Assistant Administrator at Midtown Assisted Living Residence, a community serving adults ages 18–75 with Limited Mental Health diagnoses.
At Dade Juvenile Detention Center, I worked directly with adolescents experiencing mental health challenges and substance-use issues. That experience taught me something that has stayed with me throughout my career: behavior is often communication. Behind anger, defiance, withdrawal, or poor decisions can be a young person who is struggling, afraid, overwhelmed, or simply does not yet have the tools to express what they need. Working with adolescents requires structure and accountability, but it also requires patience, consistency, emotional intelligence, and the ability to build trust.
My experience at Midtown allowed me to take those skills into a leadership role. As Assistant Administrator, I was responsible for supporting the day-to-day operations of a behavioral health environment while working closely with residents, families, staff, healthcare professionals, and outside partners. I managed challenging situations, supported crisis intervention and de-escalation efforts, addressed staff performance and training needs, and helped maintain compliance within a highly regulated environment.
I also bring a strong people-operations and leadership background. As a SHRM-CP certified professional, I understand that successful programs depend not only on the individuals receiving services, but also on the people providing them. I believe in hiring the right people, setting clear expectations, developing staff, holding teams accountable, and creating a culture where employees understand that their work can fundamentally impact someone's life.
What I would bring to Adolescent Wellness Academy is the ability to see both sides of the operation: the human side and the leadership side. I can connect with a young person who is struggling while also understanding the importance of documentation, policies, staffing, compliance, communication, and operational accountability.
Most importantly, I don't believe adolescents should be defined by their diagnosis, their mistakes, their circumstances, or the hardest chapter of their lives. I believe our responsibility as professionals is to help create an environment where they can develop the skills, confidence, and support necessary to write a different chapter.
I would be honored to bring my experience, leadership, and passion for behavioral health to Adolescent Wellness Academy. I am excited about the possibility of contributing to a team that is doing work that can have a lasting impact on the lives of young people and their families.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss what I can bring to the Adolescent Wellness Academy team.
Sincerely,
Tia Baskin

I also understand that successful adolescent programming requires more than structure—it requires building trusting relationships and creating an environment where young people feel respected, supported, and capable of growth.

My graduate training in Applied Behavior Analysis has given me a strong foundation in behavior management, ethical practice, data-driven decision-making, reinforcement strategies, and individualized intervention. I am also pursuing opportunities within education and student services, making this position an exciting opportunity to apply my behavioral expertise while growing into a leadership role.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring my clinical perspective, professionalism, organization, and passion for supporting young people and families to AWA. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my background can contribute to the success of your adolescent program.

Sincerely,

Nadirah Wilds

To the Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest  in the  Program Operations Supervisor position with AWA.  After viewing the job description posted on zip recruiter, I feel that my experience in a variety of roles in youth services makes me an ideal candidate to be an asset to the organization.

As an experienced servant leader in managing behavioral health, residential, health/wellness and independent living programming for youth and families in crisis, I have dedicated a career in improving quality of life and independent living outcomes for the most vulnerable in our community.

In my executive leadership roles with my previous employer, I improved the quality of life of program participants by implementing residential living space upgrades, updating policy and procedures to include improved oversight of living areas, solicit participant feedback in lived experience and performance/quality improvement initiatives.  I also led the team in securing initial accreditation and re-accreditation from COA for the youth services and housing programs including behavioral health programming.

I was also fortunate to provide non-violent crisis intervention training to employees as a Crisis Prevention Institute (CPI) certified trainer,  designed and implemented a Trauma Informed Care training curriculum as a certified train the trainer, enhanced intake procedures for victims of human trafficking seeking services and implemented data driven evaluation through a client management system to efficiently track progress towards desired client outcomes.  As a result of the above actions, the organization saw improved consistency in behavioral intervention techniques, a reduction in participant incidents, improved outcomes and an improved overall experience for the youth served and the employees who serve them.

In summary, I am a dedicated advocate for the health, wellness and potential of youth who's voice and need is often lost in a system of services dedicated to meet the needs of adults or fails to recognize the unique needs of the individual.  I am reliable, consistent, detail oriented and a likable team member.  I am a fair employee supervisor who prefers to build upon employee strengths but understands the need to implement corrective action when necessary.  I am experienced in scheduling  shift coverage, responding to staff crisis and motivating employees to find joy in their work.  

I have found my work in serving youth in need to be not just a rewarding career choice but a calling to serve that aligns with my faith and values.  It is my hope that the hiring team will see value in my skills and experience and initiate further conversation on how I can help AWA further its mission.

I hope to hear back from you soon.

Sincerely,

Nelson Bogren, BS, MA
954-675-5284
academyc@hotmail.com

candidates.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager:

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Program Operations Supervisor – Adolescent Mental Health position. As a Florida Licensed Clinical Social Worker with more than 30 years of experience in mental health, crisis intervention, school-based behavioral health, family services, and clinical program coordination, I offer a combination of clinical expertise, leadership experience, and a strong commitment to improving outcomes for adolescents and their families.

Throughout my career, I have worked extensively with children and adolescents experiencing significant emotional, behavioral, and mental-health challenges. During my tenure with Broward County Public Schools, I provided intensive individual and group therapy to students with emotional and behavioral disabilities, developed therapeutic and educational plans, collaborated with multidisciplinary teams, supported families, and provided therapeutic training to school personnel. I also served as a Head Start Social Worker and Family Counselor, providing behavioral interventions, family support, case coordination, and consultation to address barriers to students' academic, social, and emotional development.

My experience with Henderson Behavioral Health further strengthened my ability to manage complex behavioral-health situations. As a Mobile Response Team Clinician and Crisis Stabilization Unit Screener, I conducted clinical assessments, provided crisis intervention, determined appropriate levels of care, coordinated inpatient admissions, and collaborated with law enforcement, courts, healthcare providers, and community agencies. These experiences have given me a strong understanding of the operational demands involved in delivering timely, effective, and coordinated behavioral-health services.

In addition to my clinical background, I bring extensive experience working within multidisciplinary environments and coordinating services among clinicians, educators, families, administrators, and community partners. I understand the importance of maintaining high clinical standards while also ensuring that programs operate efficiently, staff receive appropriate support, documentation and regulatory requirements are met, and clients receive services that are responsive to their individual needs.

I am particularly interested in this opportunity because adolescent mental health requires both strong clinical leadership and an understanding of the systems surrounding young people. Adolescents often face complex challenges involving family dynamics, school performance, trauma, behavioral concerns, substance use, peer relationships, and emerging mental-health conditions. I am passionate about helping organizations develop programs that address these needs while empowering staff to provide compassionate, evidence-informed, and culturally responsive care.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring my extensive clinical experience, leadership abilities, crisis-intervention expertise, and commitment to adolescent mental health to your organization. I am confident that my background would allow me to make a meaningful contribution as a Program Operations Supervisor.

Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my experience and qualifications align with the needs of your program.

Sincerely,

Mareo Hood, LCSW
Licensed Clinical Social Worker

Dear Hiring Manager,
I am writing to express my interest in the Learning Specialist position with your psychological and learning center. As an experienced educator with a strong background in working directly with students, developing individualized instruction, and creating supportive learning environments, I am excited about the opportunity to help children and adolescents strengthen their academic skills, executive functioning, confidence, and independence.
Throughout my teaching experience, I have worked with students with a wide range of learning styles, abilities, and educational needs. I understand that students do not all process information or develop skills in the same way, and I have learned to adjust my approach accordingly. Whether working individually with a student or in a classroom setting, I strive to provide clear structure, achievable goals, encouragement, and strategies that help students experience meaningful progress.
My background as a music educator has also given me extensive experience developing many of the executive functioning skills highlighted in this position. Learning and performing music requires sustained attention, organization, working memory, planning, self-monitoring, discipline, and the ability to break complex tasks into manageable steps. In my work with students, I regularly reinforce these skills while helping them develop effective practice and learning strategies that can transfer to other areas of their education.
I am particularly drawn to your practice’s holistic, child-centered philosophy and emphasis on collaboration among students, families, schools, and professionals. I value building positive relationships with students while maintaining structured, goal-oriented expectations. I also understand the importance of communicating clearly and professionally with parents, teachers, and colleagues to ensure that students receive consistent support.
In addition to my educational experience, I bring patience, reliability, strong interpersonal skills, and a genuine commitment to helping young people succeed. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute these strengths to your multidisciplinary team while continuing to develop my knowledge of educational therapy, executive functioning interventions, and evidence-based learning strategies.
Thank you for considering my application. I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss how my background and experience could contribute to your team and the students and families you serve. I look forward to hearing from you.
Sincerely,

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in a professional position where I can utilize my extensive background in education, behavioral health, case management, supervision, and social services. With 15 years of teaching experience, including 7 years in supervisory and leadership capacities, combined with 7 years as a Regional Case Manager serving juveniles across six South Florida counties, I bring a comprehensive understanding of educational, behavioral, mental health, medical, and social-service systems. My experience has equipped me with the ability to lead teams, manage complex cases, build collaborative relationships, conduct detailed assessments, maintain regulatory compliance, and advocate effectively for individuals and families.

Throughout my career in education, I have developed strong skills in instruction, assessment, intervention planning, documentation, staff collaboration, and program oversight. My seven years in supervisory roles strengthened my leadership abilities and provided extensive experience supporting staff, monitoring performance, resolving challenges, implementing policies and procedures, and ensuring that organizational expectations and professional standards were consistently met.

A significant component of my professional experience has been my seven years as a Regional Case Manager responsible for juveniles determined to be mentally incompetent to proceed, with responsibilities spanning six counties throughout South Florida. In this role, I worked closely with juvenile clients, families, behavioral health professionals, attorneys, court personnel, service providers, and other stakeholders. I established and fostered professional relationships with the judicial systems in each county, requiring effective communication, sound judgment, confidentiality, cultural competency, and the ability to navigate complex systems while maintaining the best interests of the youth at the center of my work.

My case management background extends beyond juvenile services and includes mental health and medical case management across various age groups and populations. I have experience coordinating services, identifying client needs, connecting individuals with appropriate resources, monitoring treatment and service plans, advocating for clients, documenting progress, and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams. These responsibilities have strengthened my ability to assess situations holistically and develop practical, individualized approaches to addressing behavioral health, medical, educational, family, and social-service needs.

I also bring extensive experience conducting and interpreting assessments, maintaining comprehensive case records, monitoring documentation, and preparing for annual audits of client files. I understand the importance of accurate, timely, and compliant documentation and have consistently worked to ensure that records meet organizational, contractual, and regulatory expectations. My experience includes reviewing files for completeness and accuracy, identifying deficiencies, following corrective processes, maintaining confidentiality, and ensuring that required services and documentation are properly tracked.

Academically, I hold a Master of Science in Reading Education and a Bachelor of Arts in Psychology, providing me with a strong foundation in educational development, human behavior, assessment, learning, and intervention. I am also currently pursuing a Master of Social Work (MSW), which I expect to obtain in December 2026. This combination of education, psychology, social work, case management, and leadership experience has given me a multidisciplinary perspective that allows me to understand individuals not simply from one professional lens, but within the broader context of their educational, behavioral, medical, family, and social environments.

I am particularly proud of my ability to build meaningful professional partnerships while simultaneously maintaining accountability and high standards. Whether working with judicial professionals, educators, clinicians, families, community providers, or organizational leadership, I approach each relationship with professionalism, respect, and a solutions-oriented mindset. I am comfortable managing competing priorities, working with complex and high-needs populations, meeting deadlines, maintaining detailed records, and adapting to changing organizational and client needs.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring my 15 years of educational experience, 7 years of supervisory leadership, 7 years of regional case management, behavioral health and medical case management expertise, assessment and audit experience, and multidisciplinary academic preparation to your organization. I am confident that my combination of leadership, case management, advocacy, assessment, compliance, and relationship-building skills would allow me to make a meaningful contribution to your team and the individuals you serve.

Thank you for considering my application. I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss how my background, qualifications, and commitment to service can support the goals of your organization. I look forward to the possibility of speaking with you.

Sincerely, 


Sandra Cowell, MS CBHCM

Dear Hiring Team at Adolescent Wellness Academy,

I am excited to apply for a clinical position with Adolescent Wellness Academy. With 11 years of experience in mental health and substance use disorder treatment, along with experience supporting children and adolescents in an elementary-school setting, I would bring a compassionate, structured, and youth-centered approach to your team.

Throughout my career, I have provided individual and group counseling, facilitated psychoeducational and process groups, completed clinical documentation, supported treatment planning, and helped clients navigate co-occurring mental-health and substance-use concerns. My work has strengthened my ability to build rapport quickly, manage group dynamics, respond calmly to crises, and create a respectful environment where clients feel seen, heard, and safe.

While I am not yet independently licensed, I hold a master’s-level clinical background and bring substantial direct-care experience. I understand the importance of working within my scope of practice, seeking appropriate supervision, maintaining ethical boundaries, and collaborating closely with multidisciplinary teams, families, schools, and community providers. My elementary-school experience also gave me meaningful insight into the developmental, behavioral, emotional, and academic needs that can affect children and adolescents.

I am especially drawn to Adolescent Wellness Academy’s focus on providing compassionate, family-centered care for teens experiencing mental-health, behavioral, and substance-use challenges. Your PHP and IOP model—which combines therapeutic support with school connection and family involvement—aligns closely with my belief that adolescents do best when treatment addresses the whole person and their support system.
I would welcome the opportunity to contribute my clinical experience, strong group-facilitation skills, documentation abilities, and genuine commitment to helping young people build stability, insight, coping skills, and hope. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can support the adolescents, families, and clinical team at Adolescent Wellness Academy.

Sincerely,  

Mia Williams

With more than 10 years of experience managing operations in fast-paced, highly regulated environments, I have developed a strong ability to lead teams, coordinate complex daily workflows, manage competing priorities, and maintain structure and accountability in environments where accuracy, communication, and responsiveness are essential.

In my current leadership role, I serve as a central point of coordination for daily team operations. I oversee staffing needs, scheduling, onboarding, training, performance management, workflow monitoring, and operational follow-up. I regularly identify gaps or issues that could impact productivity or service delivery, determine the appropriate course of action, and work with team members and leadership to resolve them quickly and effectively.

A significant part of my experience involves working in compliance-driven environments where accurate documentation, timely follow-up, and attention to detail are critical. I monitor performance and quality metrics, review documentation for accuracy, maintain standard operating procedures, and ensure team members understand and follow established processes. I am comfortable identifying potential compliance concerns, escalating issues appropriately, and taking corrective action before they become larger operational problems.

I also understand the importance of effective communication when managing a team in a fast-paced environment. I regularly lead team meetings and huddles, provide coaching and feedback, delegate responsibilities, and hold team members accountable for expectations and deadlines. When unexpected issues arise, I remain calm, assess the situation, prioritize what needs immediate attention, and communicate clear direction to keep operations moving forward.

Many of the skills I have developed translate directly to AWA's program environment. I have experience coordinating people and resources, managing daily workflows, maintaining accurate records, supporting compliance requirements, resolving operational barriers, and ensuring that teams have the structure and direction they need to provide consistent service.

What particularly interests me about AWA is the opportunity to apply my operational leadership experience in an organization focused on supporting adolescents and their families. I understand that strong operations are essential to creating a safe, organized, and dependable environment for both clients and staff. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my experience, accountability, organization, and hands-on leadership style to your team.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my background and operational leadership experience I can contribute to AWA's continued success.

Sincerely,

Crystal Dave

I am currently working as a Case Manager at Broward Partnership for the Homeless, where I began my journey in human services in July 2025. This experience has been incredibly valuable and has allowed me to grow both professionally and personally while developing a deeper understanding of the needs of the individuals and families I serve.
When I began this position, I anticipated maintaining a caseload of approximately 30 clients, which I understood would allow me to provide each individual with the attention, advocacy, and support they deserve. However, my caseload has grown to approximately 50 clients. While I remain committed to serving my clients effectively, the increased workload has made it challenging to provide the level of individualized service I believe is essential to being an effective case manager.
I initially intended to supplement my income by working a second job, but the demands of my current caseload make that unrealistic. My current salary is approximately $45,000 annually, and I am seeking an opportunity that provides greater financial stability while allowing me to remain fully committed to a career in human services.
I am passionate about helping others and want to continue building my career in this field. I am looking for an organization where I can bring my experience, compassion, and dedication to the work while earning a salary that provides the financial stability necessary for me to focus fully on my professional responsibilities. My goal is to find a position where I can be fully engaged, give 100% to the individuals I serve, and continue growing as a human services professional.

Reason for Leaving:
questionnaire.response:
In my previous position, I served as a Residential Program Director with Sunrise Community, where I was responsible for overseeing two group homes and supervising a team of approximately 20 staff members. My salary was $45,000 yearly but was raised to $55,000 after 3 months. This role was highly rewarding and provided me with valuable experience supporting individuals with mental health and intellectual disabilities. I found the work especially meaningful because it allowed me to advocate for the individuals we served while ensuring they received appropriate care, support, and services.

During my tenure (July 2024-2025), one of the homes under my supervision was closed, and I was subsequently transferred to Miami to manage two additional residential homes. This transition presented several significant operational challenges, including the need to work directly on the staff floor while simultaneously fulfilling my managerial responsibilities. In addition, there were ongoing operational and compliance concerns within the homes that created potential liabilities.

I made every effort to address these concerns through the appropriate management channels and advocated for the necessary corrective actions. Unfortunately, when several of the issues remained unresolved despite my efforts to bring them to upper management's attention, I ultimately made the difficult decision to leave the organization.

Despite the circumstances surrounding my departure, I remain grateful for the experience and the opportunity to serve individuals with disabilities. The position strengthened my leadership, problem-solving, staff-management, advocacy, and crisis-management skills, all of which continue to shape my approach to working in human services.

candidates.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Facility Manager – Adolescent Mental Health position with Adolescent Wellness Academy. I bring a multidisciplinary background in healthcare operations, integrative health and wellness, behavioral health support, program development, client and family engagement, and healthcare coordination. Throughout my career, I have focused on creating organized, compassionate, patient-centered environments while building strong relationships with healthcare professionals, staff, clients, and families.

In my current role as Lead Integrative Therapist with CareRite Centers in South Florida, I deliver and coordinate integrative health and wellness programming across multiple skilled nursing and rehabilitation facilities. I work closely with facility administrators, nursing leadership, interdisciplinary clinical teams, staff, residents, caregivers, and families to support consistent program delivery, staff engagement, health education, and patient-centered care. Working across multiple facilities has strengthened my ability to manage competing priorities, adapt quickly to different operational environments, identify needs, communicate effectively with leadership, and maintain continuity and quality across programs.

A significant part of my work involves supporting individuals and families navigating cognitive, emotional, behavioral, and psychosocial challenges. I also provide staff-focused wellness and educational initiatives designed to strengthen engagement, stress management, communication, and the overall care environment. My approach combines compassion with structure, accountability, clear communication, and a strong focus on the individual experience.

My previous healthcare experience also includes client services and healthcare support coordination involving multiple behavioral health and substance-use treatment facilities. In that environment, I gained valuable exposure to behavioral healthcare operations, insurance and benefits processes, documentation, provider and facility communication, multidisciplinary coordination, and the importance of maintaining organized services for individuals and families experiencing complex circumstances.

Education and continuous professional development are also central to my career. I am currently completing my Bachelor of Health Services Administration at Florida International University. My additional healthcare education includes training through Harvard Medical School, Mayo Clinic, the National Institutes of Health and National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, and The University of Texas at Austin School of Nursing. My studies have included behavioral and integrative health, healthcare leadership, quality improvement, dementia and person-centered care, gerontology, infection prevention, clinical care for autistic adults, palliative care, and healthcare program improvement.

What particularly attracts me to Adolescent Wellness Academy is the opportunity to bring together the areas that have defined my professional development: behavioral health, healthcare operations, program leadership, staff engagement, multidisciplinary collaboration, and compassionate care. I understand that effective behavioral healthcare requires more than efficient operations. It requires an environment where clients and families feel respected, staff feel supported, communication remains strong, and every part of the organization works toward a consistent standard of care.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring my healthcare experience, leadership abilities, organizational skills, bilingual English-Spanish communication, and commitment to quality and compassionate care to Adolescent Wellness Academy. I am prepared for the next step in my career and would be honored to contribute to an organization dedicated to supporting adolescents and their families during such an important period of their lives.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my background and experience can contribute to the continued success of Adolescent Wellness Academy.

Sincerely,

Piero Ballen
